target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays — long-term Purola/North Hays documentation; Travis — Balcones Canyonlands Preserve list; Williamson — UT Plant Resources Center county treatment.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not convert historical ambiguous varietal/specimen labels into county PASS.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with life cycle and the sheaths. Poverty dropseed is an annual, usually much smaller than the perennial dropseeds, and it produces cleistogamous flowers hidden in the upper leaf sheaths. That hidden-sheath reproduction is a strong confirmation character.
diagnostic_traits: very narrow leaves about 1–2 mm wide
